_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated. --spark-synchronize-model leaves it alone: SparkUser is not a
context root and not an embedded type, so the synchronizer never discovers it and never rewrites
It exists so that ApiToken.CreatedByUserId renders a username instead of a raw document id.
A reference resolves its label through the target type's breadcrumb, and with no model file at
all BreadcrumbResolver falls back to the id string.
⚠️ DO NOT register SparkUser on CoverageSparkContext to get this generated instead. The
synchronizer discovers properties by reflection, so it would emit PasswordHash, SecurityStamp,
AuthenticatorKey, TwoFactorRecoveryCodes and Claims as writable, projectable model attributes --
in production -- and [IgnoreProperty] cannot prevent it, because SparkUser is a library type this
app does not own. Hand-authoring is what lets this file declare one field and stop. (It also
declared Id until #264; the identity travels as the object's own id, so that was dead.)
⚠️ The breadcrumb names UserName (capital N). A placeholder that matches no attribute renders
blank rather than raising an error, so a typo here is silent.
⚠️ Nothing may be added here without asking what it discloses. SparkUser has no actions class and
therefore no row rule -- RowSecurity treats a missing rule as allowed -- so any attribute in this
file is readable by anyone who can read a token that references the user. Email and PhoneNumber
are deliberately absent for that reason.
